parameter.name: components
parameter.label: Price Components
parameter.description: What your effective consumption price is made of, in the order it is summed, for example spot, gridTariff and taxesAndFees. Empty composes nothing: there is no shipped default, because a wholesale price presented as a consumer price would be wrong on every bill.

options.option: Something the other components do not describe

parameter.name: preferredSources
parameter.label: Preferred Price Sources
parameter.description: Which source to prefer for a price component, written as role:sourceId, for example spot:entsoe. Empty prefers the highest ranked source of each role.

parameter.name: alignment
parameter.label: Component Alignment
parameter.description: How components whose slots do not line up are brought onto one set of slots before they are summed. Refining keeps every value over exactly the time it was in force; resampling gives a regular series; refusing tells you your inputs disagree instead of composing them.
